title: Gerente de Contas - Rio de Janeiro
description:
Estamos em busca de pessoas que tenham valores alinhados aos nossos: Atitude de dono, História de transformação, Relações duradouras e Ser presente .

Na MAG, temos o forte propósito de prover soluções financeiras individuais nos diversos momentos de vida de todos os brasileiros.

Nos últimos três anos, realizamos o pagamento de mais de R$ 1 bilhão em benefícios a milhares de famílias. Dados como esses nos levam a ser referência no mercado de Vida e Previdência, com quase 200 anos de atuação ininterrupta no Brasil.

Somos parte do Grupo Aegon, um dos maiores grupos de Seguro de Vida e Previdência do mundo. No Brasil, nossa força também impressiona: temos mais de 5,8 milhões de vidas seguradas e um crescimento médio anual de 20% na última década.

Quer fazer parte dessa história? Conheça a nossa oportunidade.

  1. Atendimento da base de agentes autônomos e escritórios de investimentos, realizando a interface com a MAG Seguros;
  2. Capacitação dos distribuidores em produtos, processos e sistemas da companhia;
  3. Fomento da venda de seguros e de incentivos à força de vendas em escritórios parceiros;
  4. Acompanhamento dos resultados de vendas dos parceiros;
  5. Reporte, à liderança imediata, das atividades de vendas realizadas, para suporte e acompanhamento no desenvolvimento para o negócio.
  6. Experiência comercial e com rotina de vendas externas;
  7. Perfil ativo nas redes sociais;
  8. Domínio do pacote office;
  9. Disponibilidade para viagens.

Você se diferenciará, se possuir:

  1. Experiência com venda consultiva, venda de serviços e rotina de vendas externas;
  2. Vivência no mercado segurador, preferencialmente no segmento de vida e previdência;
  3. Possuir certificações do mercado financeiro;
  4. Superior completo, certificações ou pós-graduação em áreas afins ao negócio.

PESSOAS BEM-SUCEDIDAS NESSA PROFISSÃO:

  • Possuem excelente relacionamento com os escritórios parceiros e base de agentes autônomos de investimentos, com uma agenda recorrente de visitas e acompanhamento de follow-up;
  • São ágeis no atendimento das demandas do parceiro, fazendo a interface com a seguradora, facilitando a venda de seguros e previdência;
  • Possuem boa habilidade de comunicação e domínio técnico do negócio, atuando como multiplicadores na capacitação dos parceiros;
  • Participam de campanhas de vendas e sentem-se motivados pelos atingimentos das metas.

Há mais de 190 anos, temos como propósito prover soluções financeiras individuais nos diversos momentos de vida de todos os brasileiros.

Para isso, contamos com a dedicação de mais de 1.500 colaboradores em todo o país, que vestem a camisa deste time e nos fazem ser uma das melhores companhias para trabalhar no Brasil.

A cultura MAG é sustentada por nossos valores corporativos , que são reflexo do comportamento que manifestamos, de quem somos e muito nos orgulhamos:

  • Relações Duradouras
  • Uma história de transformação

Somos uma empresa PLURAL!

Diversidade e inclusão é uma pauta constante na MAG. Nos orgulhamos de ter na companhia mais de 80% dos colaboradores pertencentes a, pelo menos, um grupo minorizado.

Contamos com o Plural , programa formal, estruturado e direcionado ao fomento da diversidade e inclusão . Acreditamos que este pilar é fundamental para a construção de uma sociedade mais justa e de uma companhia mais humana, inovadora e forte.

Valorização dos colaboradores é uma prioridade para nós e isso se reflete na extensa lista de benefícios que oferecemos:

  • Capacitação contínua e programas de desenvolvimento ofertados pela MAG Universidade
  • Campanhas de vendas competitivas com premiações e viagens nacionais e internacionais

description:
Overview

Job type: Full-time employee

Somos a PRIO, a maior companhia independente de óleo e gás do Brasil. Buscamos continuamente por otimização de processos operacionais e de soluções inovadoras que visem diminuir os custos. Aqui todo trabalho é multidisciplinar e cada desafio é único!

Missão do cargo

Coordenar a equipe responsável por prover apoio técnico às unidades de produção, com equipe especializada, promovendo segurança e eficiência das operações. Promover um ambiente de trabalho colaborativo e motivador, estimulando o engajamento da equipe e o desenvolvimento contínuo dos profissionais. Atuar com foco em segurança operacional, excelência técnica e cultura de prevenção, garantindo que as atividades sejam realizadas com responsabilidade, eficiência e respeito à vida.

Responsabilidades

  • Coordenar o suporte técnico de segundo nível para equipamentos dinâmicos, sistemas elétricos, automação e instrumentação , realizando diagnósticos e troubleshooting em falhas complexas, embarcando esporadicamente para atendimento emergencial offshore e mantendo contato próximo com operações para alinhamento técnico contínuo.
  • Planejar e acompanhar ações corretivas e alternativas técnicas para falhas funcionais , atuando junto às equipes onshore e offshore, propondo soluções técnicas viáveis e apoiando na elaboração de planos de ação e priorização de recursos.
  • Atender chamados técnicos via Flow e Greendocs , analisando criticidade e urgência dos chamados, direcionando para resolução técnica adequada, registrando histórico e ações tomadas.
  • Participar de projetos nas fases FEL-1 , contribuindo com estimativas de custo e escopo técnico no EVTE e validando viabilidade de execução e integração com sistemas existentes.
  • Representar tecnicamente a área em situações críticas e emergenciais , participando de salas de guerra e interdições, elaborando respostas técnicas para órgãos reguladores e coordenando ações imediatas com stakeholders internos e externos.
  • Gerenciar tecnicamente contratos e fornecedores , desenvolvendo memoriais descritivos (MD), acompanhando entregas pontuais e conformidade técnica, avaliando desempenho e propondo melhorias.
  • Elaborar e revisar TBE (Technical Bid Evaluation) de grandes equipamentos , definindo critérios técnicos de avaliação, comparando propostas de fornecedores, recomendando alternativas mais adequadas ao escopo do projeto.
  • Avaliar e implantar recomendações de segurança e mudanças técnicas , participando da gestão de mudanças, propondo execução de melhorias, garantindo conformidade com normas e diretrizes de segurança.
  • Manter a governança técnica de sistemas de dados offshore , gerenciando o PI System e demais sistemas de monitoramento, garantindo integridade e disponibilidade das informações, promovendo uso eficiente dos dados para tomada de decisão.
  • Gerenciar a governança de turbomáquinas , monitorando desempenho e confiabilidade operacional, garantindo disponibilidade dos ativos críticos, desenvolvendo padrões técnicos e estratégias de manutenção mais eficazes, propondo ações de melhoria, garantindo suporte técnico especializado.
  • Gerenciar OT (Operational Technology) , avaliando redes industriais e obsolescência, implementando medidas de segurança cibernética, garantindo integridade dos sistemas de automação.
  • Assegurar a integridade e conformidade legal dos sistemas de rádio e telecomunicações , realizando o licenciamento junto à ANATEL e CINDACTA, conduzindo inspeções de abrangência de sinal VHF/UHF e antenas, executando inspeções de abrangência sonora do sistema PAGA.

Formação acadêmica

  • Ensino superior completo em Engenharia (preferencialmente Mecânica, Elétrica, Automação ou áreas correlatas)
  • Pós-graduação ou MBA em áreas técnicas ou de gestão será considerado um diferencial

Experiência prévia desejada

  • Diagnóstico e troubleshooting de falhas complexas em:
  • Equipamentos dinâmicos (ex.: turbomáquinas)
  • Sistemas elétricos, automação e instrumentação
  • Conhecimento em sistemas de monitoramento como PI System
  • Familiaridade com redes industriais e tecnologia operacional (OT)
  • Gestão de contratos técnicos e fornecedores
  • Elaboração e análise de TBE (Technical Bid Evaluation)
  • Licenciamento e conformidade legal de sistemas de rádio e telecomunicações (ANATEL, CINDACTA)
  • Normas e diretrizes de segurança operacional
  • Inglês avançado

Processo seletivo

Como é o processo seletivo na PRIO? Gostamos de já chegar na entrevista te conhecendo um pouco, então pedimos a você que preencha ainda na etapa de cadastro alguns testes para podermos avaliar o seu Match com a nossa Cultura. Depois, nós do time de RH vamos marcar um papo com você. A ideia aqui é aprofundar um pouco mais nas suas experiências, buscando o alinhamento com o perfil da vaga e comportamental que buscamos para a PRIO. Ah, nesse papo também vamos falar sobre a companhia, fluxo do processo, benefícios e tirar suas dúvidas!

Dica: Nesse nosso papo, vamos querer saber sobre experiências que você já vivenciou, alinhadas aos valores da PRIO. A ideia é que você possa nos apresentar essas vivências de forma completa, com contextos, sua responsabilidade, o que você fez e qual foi o resultado!

Em seguida, vamos adentrando em aspectos mais técnicos, que podem envolver um case ou apenas uma entrevista com o(a) gestor(a) da vaga, aonde você poderá conhecer um pouco mais sobre os desafios técnicos da vaga e será avaliado dentro dos requisitos da vaga. Ao fim, os finalistas conversam com o diretor da respectiva área para a escolha final!

Como se preparar para o processo seletivo na PRIO:

-Pesquise sobre o negócio da companhia e nossa atuação no setor de óleo e gás;

-Busque se atualizar sobre as notícias recentes da companhia, sejam da imprensa ou divulgadas em nosso site de relações com investidores;

-Acesses nossas redes sociais para conhecer mais sobre como é trabalhar na PRIO!

-Pense na sua história e principais realizações. Estruture seus resultados e conquistas para relatá-los na hora da entrevista.

Fale dos sucessos, mas entender as falhas e como você aprendeu com elas também é importante. Prezamos pela transparência, por isso, não tenha medo de falar sobre os seus insucessos.

Desejamos a você um bom processo seletivo!

Ambiente de trabalho

Somos a PRIO, a maior companhia independente de óleo e gás do Brasil. Buscamos continuamente por otimização de processos operacionais e de soluções inovadoras que visem diminuir os custos. Aqui todo trabalho é multidisciplinar e cada desafio é único!

Com foco no investimento e na recuperação de ativos em produção, somos especializados na gestão eficiente de reservatórios e no redesenvolvimento de campos maduros. Acreditamos na condução dos negócios, com foco em segurança e cuidado com a saúde dos seus colaboradores.

Nosso ambiente de trabalho

Oferecemos um ambiente de trabalho dinâmico e com muitas oportunidades de participação em diferentes projetos, favorecendo o desenvolvimento profissional e o crescimento do time. Trabalhamos em um escritório open space, o que permite a integração entre todas as equipes e a Diretoria, onde todos podem participar da tomada de decisões. Nossa cultura busca o alto desempenho e a participação efetiva de todas as pessoas. Se você sonha em se desenvolver junto com uma empresa em constante crescimento, venha fazer parte do nosso time!

title: Executive Director of Strategic Transactions
description:
Overview

This executive leadership position is responsible for leading and directing complex real estate transactions from beginning to end for the capital asset portfolio. The incumbent will have oversight of a diverse portfolio and will work with the University and external partners to drive key objectives and optimize financial and mission-oriented performance of real estate transactions.

Must be able to organize and prioritize multiple tasks, effectively manage through stressful situations, and consistently make effective, high-quality decisions. Must create and support an environment that fosters teamwork, leadership development, integrity, service responsiveness and effectively manages business, regulatory agency, and internal and external relationships. This position will have overall responsibility for executing real estate transactions in conformity with the University’s strategic plan and with the approved Campus Master Plan.

Responsibilities

  • Formulates and executes strategies for long-range needs and uses of the University’s real property assets including acquisitions, development, leasing, and disposition of assets. Source and identify real estate direct investment opportunities and joint venture/equity partners, and negotiate Letters of Intent and Term Sheets.
  • Coordinate pre-transaction analysis and due diligence, including financial modeling and pro forma analysis, cost-benefit or return on investment analysis, feasibility analysis, market research, and review of third-party reports such as market demand studies, environmental assessments, appraisals, facility assessment reports, among others.
  • Execute on the University’s strategic plan and initiatives approved by Senior Administration and Board of Trustees.
  • Prepare and present transaction analysis to Senior Administration and Board of Trustee regarding structure, economics, mission benefits, progress, etc. Obtain all required Board of Trustee approvals and resolutions for real estate transaction.
  • Leads negotiations with investors and creditors, development partners, contractors, and vendors, ensuring that University policies are followed.
  • Review all real estate agreements, documents, and contracts with the Office of General Counsel to ensure compliance with University strategic plans and procedures, and compliance with pertinent District of Columbia and Maryland laws, as applicable.
  • Prepare, direct, and negotiate purchase agreements, partnership agreements, lease agreements, and other legal transaction documents needed to close transactions.
  • Maintain copies of all University deeds, leases, and other real estate documents in a central database to allow management to respond to inquiries associated with real estate.
  • Act as coordinator and liaison to the University legal, risk management, environmental, health and safety departments for all real estate related activities.
  • Cultivate relationships with Community Associations, District Government agencies, and neighborhood groups to foster positive working relationships.
  • Prepare RFQ/RFP responses for all bids, ensuring compliance to policy and procedure, including zoning laws and securing public approval.
  • Coordinates with the Chief Financial Officer or designated committee regarding the evaluation, acceptance, management, and disposition of real property assets that are donated or bequeathed to the University.
  • Provides support for a portfolio of real estate projects, entailing development, construction, property management, legal, and financial components.
  • Oversees development and review of periodic reports on finances and project performance to monitor the health of each project and the portfolio. Consults with Leadership in REDCAM, CFO, and Resident Life to prioritize work requirements.
  • Makes recommendations on processes, procedures, policies, methodologies, and metrics for managing, reviewing, measuring, and evaluating project and portfolio performance.
  • Works collaboratively with the offices of the Chief Financial Officer and other members of the Administrative Services Leadership Team.
  • Performs other related duties as assigned.

Qualifications and Core Competencies

  • Comprehensive knowledge of real estate markets and trends.
  • Ability to conduct complex structuring including joint ventures, development, and debt instruments.
  • Knowledge of underwriting and closing debt and equity transactions regionally and nationally.
  • Must possess advanced analytical skills in evaluating real estate transactions.
  • Ability to manage a transaction pipeline.
  • Ability to establish and maintain harmonious work relationships with students, staff, faculty, University and local school officials, and the general public.
  • Ability to develop processes and procedures to successfully monitor and provide project status reports by collecting, analyzing, and summarizing information and trends.
  • Ability to establish and execute projects by establishing communication plans to identify initial needs or supplemental project resources.
  • Communicates with the University community, the public, and the media regarding planning, design, and construction issues is required; Management skills, particularly in decision-making, are required.
  • Gathers and thoroughly analyzes information in order to make well-founded recommendations to the University’s Senior Administration.
  • Independent, entrepreneurial, ability to create processes to accomplish and manage acquisitions.
  • Ability to manage multiple suppliers and strategic partner relationships.
  • Broad knowledge of the principles and practices in financial management required.
  • The ability to develop knowledge of, respect for, and skills to engage with those of other cultures or backgrounds is required.
  • Strong Organizational, Management, Presentation And Communication Skills Are Required. Superior people relationship skills are required.
  • Ability to plan and manage within budget and time constraints is required. Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

Minimum Requirements

  • A Master’s Degree with a minimum of 10 years of work related experience.
  • 15 years of related work experience may be substituted in lieu of educational qualifications.
  • Demonstrated experience as a management executive in real estate transactions.

Responsibilities

  • Make the platform easier to scale, extend, and maintain, both for our team and for external developers.


Stack

Overview

The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Hiring staff “for fit” makes significant contributions to Howard University’s overall mission.

At Howard University, we prioritize well-being and professional growth.

Here Is What We Offer

  • Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus mental health support
  • Work-Life Balance: PTO, paid holidays, flexible work arrangements
  • Financial Wellness: Competitive salary, 403(b) with company match
  • Professional Development: Ongoing training, tuition reimbursement, and career advancement paths
  • Additional Perks: Wellness programs, commuter benefits, and a vibrant company culture

Join Howard University and thrive with us!

Job Purpose

The NDCF Computational Research Fellow will participate in the Neurodegeneration Computational Fellows Training Program (NDCF) at Howard University, developing and applying computational skills in neuroscience research. Under the mentorship of host labs, the fellow will contribute to analyzing datasets related to neurodegenerative diseases, such as Alzheimer’s, Parkinson’s, or traumatic brain injury (TBI), advancing the understanding of disease mechanisms. This role supports the program’s mission to train researchers in advanced mathematics, data analysis, and bioinformatics for neurodegeneration research.

Supervisory Authority

This position has no supervisory authority. The fellow will work directly under the supervision of a principal investigator or mentor in a host lab affiliated with the NDCF program, receiving guidance on research tasks and computational training.

Nature And Scope

The NDCF Computational Research Fellow will engage in interdisciplinary research within a host lab at Howard University or a partner institution, such as NIH/NINDS, focusing on computational approaches to neurodegeneration. The fellow will gain hands-on experience analyzing neurophysiological, genomic, or imaging data using tools like Python, R, or machine learning frameworks. The fellow will collaborate with researchers, other fellows, and faculty, participating in lab meetings and NDCF symposia. The role is designed to support professional growth by developing skills in data analysis and contributing to research publications. External opportunities may include presenting at conferences or collaborating with partners in the Neurodegeneration Challenge Network (NDCN) under the Chan Zuckerberg Initiative.

Principal Accountabilities

  • Assist in analyzing datasets (e.g., MRI, genomic, or microbiome data) using computational tools under the guidance of a mentor, identifying patterns or biomarkers in neurodegenerative diseases.
  • Learn and apply statistical or machine learning methods to support research on disease mechanisms, following lab protocols.
  • Support data processing tasks, such as image analysis or sequence alignment, using provided software or scripts.
  • Prepare research summaries and present findings at NDCF symposia, lab meetings, or external conferences.
  • Contribute to team discussions, collaborating with lab members to integrate computational and experimental findings.
  • Maintain accurate records of research activities and adhere to ethical standards in data handling and reporting.

Core Competencies

  • Computational Aptitude: Basic familiarity with programming (e.g., Python, R) or data analysis tools, with a strong interest in learning advanced computational techniques.
  • Analytical Thinking: Ability to approach complex datasets with curiosity and apply structured methods to derive meaningful insights under mentorship.
  • Collaboration: Strong interpersonal skills to work effectively in interdisciplinary teams, including researchers, students, and faculty.
  • Communication: Clear written and verbal communication to present research progress and engage with scientific audiences.
  • Adaptability: Eagerness to acquire new skills and adapt to evolving research tools and methodologies in a training-focused environment.

Minimum Requirements

  • Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in neuroscience, biology, computer science, bioinformatics, or a related field.
  • Experience: Some exposure to programming, data analysis, or neuroscience research through coursework, internships, or personal projects. No prior expertise required.
  • Skills: Basic familiarity with computational tools (e.g., Python, R, MATLAB, or command-line interfaces) or a strong interest in learning these skills. Introductory knowledge of statistics or data visualization is a plus.
  • Other: Demonstrated interest in neurodegeneration research and the ability to work collaboratively under mentorship guidance.

Compliance Salary Range Disclosure

$45,000-$55,000

title: Research Fellow-4
description:
Overview

The NDCF Computational Research Fellow will participate in the Neurodegeneration Computational Fellows Training Program (NDCF) at Howard University, developing and applying computational skills in neuroscience research. Under the mentorship of host labs, the fellow will contribute to analyzing datasets related to neurodegenerative diseases, such as Alzheimer’s, Parkinson’s, or traumatic brain injury (TBI), advancing the understanding of disease mechanisms. This role supports the program’s mission to train researchers in advanced mathematics, data analysis, and bioinformatics for neurodegeneration research.

Benefits

  • Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus mental health support
  • Work-Life Balance: PTO, paid holidays, flexible work arrangements
  • Financial Wellness: Competitive salary, 403(b) with company match
  • Professional Development: Ongoing training, tuition reimbursement, and career advancement paths
  • Additional Perks: Wellness programs, commuter benefits, and a vibrant company culture

Supervisory Authority

This position has no supervisory authority. The fellow will work directly under the supervision of a principal investigator or mentor in a host lab affiliated with the NDCF program, receiving guidance on research tasks and computational training.

Nature And Scope

The NDCF Computational Research Fellow will engage in interdisciplinary research within a host lab at Howard University or a partner institution, such as NIH/NINDS, focusing on computational approaches to neurodegeneration. The fellow will gain hands-on experience analyzing neurophysiological, genomic, or imaging data using tools like Python, R, or machine learning frameworks. The fellow will collaborate with researchers, other fellows, and faculty, participating in lab meetings and NDCF symposia. The role is designed to support professional growth by developing skills in data analysis and contributing to research publications. External opportunities may include presenting at conferences or collaborating with partners in the Neurodegeneration Challenge Network (NDCN) under the Chan Zuckerberg Initiative.

Principal Accountabilities

  • Assist in analyzing datasets (e.g., MRI, genomic, or microbiome data) using computational tools under the guidance of a mentor, identifying patterns or biomarkers in neurodegenerative diseases.
  • Learn and apply statistical or machine learning methods to support research on disease mechanisms, following lab protocols.
  • Support data processing tasks, such as image analysis or sequence alignment, using provided software or scripts.
  • Prepare research summaries and present findings at NDCF symposia, lab meetings, or external conferences.
  • Contribute to team discussions, collaborating with lab members to integrate computational and experimental findings.
  • Maintain accurate records of research activities and adhere to ethical standards in data handling and reporting.

Core Competencies

  • Computational Aptitude: Basic familiarity with programming (e.g., Python, R) or data analysis tools, with a strong interest in learning advanced computational techniques.
  • Analytical Thinking: Ability to approach complex datasets with curiosity and apply structured methods to derive meaningful insights under mentorship.
  • Collaboration: Strong interpersonal skills to work effectively in interdisciplinary teams, including researchers, students, and faculty.
  • Communication: Clear written and verbal communication to present research progress and engage with scientific audiences.
  • Adaptability: Eagerness to acquire new skills and adapt to evolving research tools and methodologies in a training-focused environment.

Minimum Requirements

  • Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in neuroscience, biology, computer science, bioinformatics, or a related field.
  • Experience: Some exposure to programming, data analysis, or neuroscience research through coursework, internships, or personal projects. No prior expertise required.
  • Skills: Basic familiarity with computational tools (e.g., Python, R, MATLAB, or command-line interfaces) or a strong interest in learning these skills. Introductory knowledge of statistics or data visualization is a plus.
  • Other: Demonstrated interest in neurodegeneration research and the ability to work collaboratively under mentorship guidance.

Salary Range

$45,000-$55,000

Seniority level

  • Internship

Employment type

  • Full-time

Job function

  • Research, Analyst, and Information Technology
  • Industries Online Audio and Video Media

title: Head of Sales - LATAM
description:
Who We Are

At MonetizeMore, we use AI and data to revolutionize how the advertising industry combats Invalid Traffic (IVT) and fraud. Our flagship product, Traffic Cop, is a premium solution designed to protect ad-monetized publishers and ad tech vendors from fraudulent activity.

For over 15 years, our fully remote team of 100+ professionals has been driven by four core pillars: Integrity, Collaboration, Enterprising, and Kaizen. We are culture-centric, results-driven, and obsessed with building impactful, data-powered solutions.

What It’s Like Working Here

  • Actions > Talk: Execution is everything.
  • Slack & Async First: Clear, async communication is our lifeline.
  • Challenge Everything: “Why not?” is a welcome mindset.
  • Data > Ego: Bring your bold ideas—and the numbers to back them up.
  • No Titles, Just Results: Respect is earned, not granted.
  • Fail Fast, Learn Faster: Mistakes are data. We improve from them.
  • Follow Through: We do what we say—big or small.

Your Role: Head of Sales

As our Head of Sales, you’ll be responsible for defining, leading, and executing MonetizeMore’s global sales strategy. This is a high-impact leadership role for a strategic, hands-on sales expert who can build and scale a revenue engine across international markets, with a focus on high-value enterprise clients in the ad-tech space.

What You’ll Do

  • Own & Lead the Sales Function: Drive the entire sales cycle from strategy to execution—from lead generation to contract close.
  • Set the Sales Vision: Define and execute MonetizeMore’s go-to-market strategy in collaboration with the Executive Team.
  • Drive Strategic Revenue: Target and close deals with Publishers, have existing relationships and broad based understanding around the needs of DSPs, SSPs, GCPPs, MCMs, exchanges to drive partner led sales for Traffic Cop across LATAM.
  • Build & Scale the Sales Team: Hire, coach, and manage high-performing sales talent, building a metrics-driven sales org.
  • Act as a Player-Coach: Stay hands-on in high-stakes sales conversations and negotiations while coaching others to success.
  • Present & Educate: Deliver compelling product pitches and demos tailored to client challenges and verticals.
  • Refine the Value Proposition: Work with Marketing and Product to sharpen our messaging and positioning in a competitive market.
  • Optimize Pipeline & Forecasting: Maintain an accurate sales pipeline, forecast revenue, and hit aggressive growth targets.
  • Establish Strategic Partnerships: Identify and onboard channel partners to amplify our reach and strengthen joint go-to-market efforts.
  • Inform Product & GTM Strategy: Relay market intelligence and customer feedback to help shape our product roadmap and growth initiatives.
  • Sell with AI in Mind: Understand and articulate how our AI-powered solution, Traffic Cop, solves complex fraud and IVT issues in digital advertising—positioning its technological edge as a major differentiator in the market.

Who You Are

  • Proven Sales Leader: 7–10 years of experience in SaaS, cybersecurity, or ad-tech sales, with a minimum of 3 years in a leadership role.
  • AI Fluent: You understand the fundamentals of AI and machine learning as they apply to digital advertising, fraud detection, or cybersecurity. You’re able to translate technical concepts into clear business value for enterprise clients.
  • Ad-Tech Fluent: Deep understanding of the ad-tech ecosystem—including publishers, DSPs, SSPs, and exchanges.
  • Strategic & Analytical: You use data to inform decisions and aren’t afraid to challenge the status quo.
  • Exceptional Communicator: Clear, persuasive, and confident in high-level discussions with internal and external stakeholders.
  • Global Operator: Experience working across multiple time zones and regions, especially LATAM.
  • Self-Motivated & Results-Oriented: You take initiative, thrive in ambiguity, and are relentless in pursuit of your goals.
  • Builder & Innovator: Comfortable in startup or scale-up environments with a mindset for continuous improvement.

Why Join Us

  • 100% remote with flexible work hour
  • Work with a highly driven, globally distributed team
  • Be part of a fast-growing company solving meaningful problems in the ad-tech industry
  • Opportunity to shape the sales function and leadership path in a mission-driven, data-powered company

Overview

Desde dezembro de 2015, a SPDM/PAIS é responsável, em parceria com a Secretaria Municipal de Saúde do Rio de Janeiro, pelo gerenciamento do Hospital Municipal Pedro II .

A infraestrutura do Hospital conta com dez andares, nos quais estão distribuídos os serviços de emergência e de Unidade de Tratamento Intensivo (UTI) adulta, pediátrica e neonatal; maternidade; clínica médica, cirurgia-geral e bucomaxilofacial, neurocirurgia, psiquiatria, pediatria e ortopedia. Exames de imagem (raio X, tomografia, ultrassonografia, eletrocardiografia, ecocardiografia) e laboratoriais também são realizados na unidade.

Devido à grande população de idosos da Zona Oeste, região assistida pelo Hospital Municipal Pedro II (HMPII), há duas Enfermarias destinadas ao atendimento desse público.

O Centro de Tratamento de Queimados é outro diferencial entre os serviços oferecidos, e que dispõe de uma UTI exclusiva para prevenir infecções, que podem ser muito graves para quem está com queimaduras.

Além disso, a unidade conta com a Coordenação de Emergência Regional (CER) Santa Cruz, que possui 39 leitos, e tem como objetivo absorver as demandas de menor complexidade, deixando o HMPII liberado para os casos de risco iminente de morte, necessidade de cirurgia urgente e/ou internação. Um diferencial deste CER é o fato de possuir atendimento especializado em Psiquiatria e Obstetrícia.

title: Supply Chain Specialist – Procurement
description:
Excelerate Energy is seeking a Supply Chain Specialist – Procurement to join our procurement team, focusing on fleet management-related supply chain operations. Reporting to the Global Fleet Procurement Manager, you will help develop and implement global procurement strategies aligned with our objectives and goals. Your responsibilities include managing the procurement process from fleet requisition to product and service delivery, collaborating with the Logistics Team and internal stakeholders to meet business requirements. You will cultivate strong relationships with key fleet suppliers, monitor supplier performance, and identify cost‑saving opportunities while complying with established policies and procedures in global supply chain operations.

Overview

JOB SUMMARY : As a Supply Chain Specialist - Procurement, you will play a pivotal role within our procurement team, focusing specifically on supply chain operations related to Fleet management.

Responsibilities

  • Ensure that EE Policies, Procedures and Processes are implemented, enforced, and, when applicable, reviewed, improved and created.
  • Identify, onboard and lead negotiations with local and regional vendors to increase in-country value and cost efficiencies.
  • Oversee efficient procurement activities for assigned assets and projects considering total cost, specification, quality, delivery time, delivery place, Terms & Conditions, and risk to ensure materials and services are delivered to assets as needed.
  • Obtain supplier quotes and follow up with vendors to ensure timely submission of pricing. Ensure that RFQs are evaluated, and recommendation comments are documented in the ERP system considering total cost, specification, quality, delivery time, delivery place, Terms & Conditions, and risk.
  • Ensure all procurement process supporting documentation is attached to ERP Systems and take action to attach and close out missing items.
  • Conduct procurement activities based on priority and criticality of requisitions for materials or services to be delivered on time to vessels.
  • Negotiate prices, delivery times and payment terms with vendors.
  • Collaborate with applicable stakeholders to source and launch RFQs and support negotiations and final supplier selection to optimize service/product quality, total cost, and lead-time.
  • Collaborate with VSIs to enable timely RFQ and PO approvals.
  • Issue POs for approved RFQs in a timely manner, ensuring delivery times meet required dates; inform VSI of any delays.
  • Verify that the vendor has received the PO once issued.
  • Liaise and work with the Logistics department.
  • Follow up on non-conforming products and services, investigate and close out.
  • Track and record cost savings and identify opportunities for future cost savings and efficiencies.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders on Supply Chain topics to deliver business goals and expectations.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in business administration, Supply Chain Management, Procurement, or a related field.
  • Other relevant certifications in sourcing or procurement can be advantageous.
  • Strong MS Office skills with Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, Word and Power BI.
  • Proficiency in using procurement ERP software.
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to analyze complex procurement data and derive actionable insights.
  • Strong knowledge and experience in negotiating with vendors.
  • Knowledge and experience working with Sourcing Teams and Logistics Teams and understanding the procurement interface.
  • Strong knowledge of Contracts and Contract Management.
  • Minimum 5 years of experience in supply chain, preferably in Offshore, Oil Service or Marine industry.

description:
The Wells Intervention Engineer will be responsible for designing, planning, and providing engineering support for well intervention activities to ensure safe, efficient, and cost-effective operations. This role involves close collaboration with multidisciplinary teams, service providers, and offshore personnel to optimize well performance, maintain integrity, and support production enhancement strategies.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop detailed well intervention programs, including operational procedures, equipment requirements, and risk assessments.
  • Provide engineering support during planning and execution of well intervention operations (wireline, slickline, coiled tubing, stimulation, well testing, and fishing).
  • Ensure compliance with company policies, industry standards, and regulatory requirements regarding HSE and well integrity.
  • Conduct feasibility studies and technical evaluations for proposed interventions, identifying risks and mitigation measures.
  • Prepare cost estimates, schedules, and materials forecasts for intervention operations.
  • Monitor and analyze intervention performance, providing lessons learned and recommendations for continuous improvement.
  • Support the development of long-term well integrity and production optimization strategies.
  • Liaise with contractors, service companies, and internal stakeholders to align technical solutions with operational needs.
  • Contribute to incident investigations and root cause analysis related to well operations.


Education:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Petroleum Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or related field..

Knowledge and Skills:

  • Knowledge of well intervention techniques, well integrity principles, and downhole tools.
  • Good understanding of industry standards (API, ISO, NORSOK) and well control principles

title: Senior Surveyor
description:
Overview

UTEC, part of Acteon Group, is one of the world's largest independent offshore and onshore survey providers. We provide a wide range of survey, positioning and data management services using the most advanced equipment and techniques. The data we generate provides our clients with the information they need to make critical, well informed, business decisions.

UTEC is looking to add a Senior Surveyor to the team. The Senior Surveyor is UTEC's senior representative on a watch reporting to Party Chief or senior representative on vessel and must ensure that all work is conducted in the best interests of UTEC and the Client. He/She must thoroughly understand work specifications, project requirements and client objectives, and is responsible for the safe, efficient and timely execution of, as well as Quality Assurance for the project.

The role is based offshore and will require travel to support UTEC operations, periods of onshore support may also be required working either remotely or from UTEC offices/workshops.

The successful candidates will be based in Brazil.

Duties

  • Supervise survey operations ensuring safe working practices at all times and with due regard to contractual requirements, scope of work, procedures and regulations
  • Manage mobilization and demobilization activities with regard to safety of personnel and assets
  • Ensure all systems are functioning in compliance with contractual requirements, project procedures and company procedures to effectively conduct the scope of work
  • Ensure collection, collation, QC and distribution of all survey data relating to the scope of work as per project procedures and company procedures
  • Advise onshore management, company and client representatives when deviation from the approved procedure is necessary and record through the Management of Change Procedure
  • Compile operational / field reporting in a concise manner and in accordance with project procedures, client specifications and company procedures
  • Complete final reporting and data transfer / backup in accordance with project procedures, client specifications and company procedures
  • Effectively communicate with client representatives and company representatives onshore
  • Ensure all personnel in the offshore team understand their roles and responsibilities
  • Conduct personnel performance reviews/appraisals for your direct reports and provide specific performance data/feedback to supervisors of non-direct reports assigned to your projects
  • Actively participate and lead by example in the Company's Quality and HSE systems and procedures
  • Understand and comply with UTEC policies and procedures
  • Be prepared to "Stop the Job" in the event that yourself, others or equipment may be exposed to injury / damage
  • Comply with all Health and Safety instructions from UTEC
  • Correctly handle all Health and Safety equipment
  • Recognize and help control HSE hazards where applicable
  • Report all Health, Safety and Environment incidents to management, including near misses, unsafe acts and hazards
  • Utilize the Safety Observation Sheet (SOS) reporting system
  • Help generate, update and review risk assessments and job safety analysis, where applicable
  • Understand emergency plans, alarms and actions required in the event of an emergency
  • Participate in relevant HSE meetings and "tool box talks" within respective department
  • Demonstrate conversance with the Project HSE Plan where applicable to this position/department
  • Participate in accident investigations where required
  • Assume all employee responsibilities listed in the Workplace Safety and Health Act
  • Comply with return-to-work and / or rehabilitation program(s)
  • Adhere to the 'UTEC Way 12 Safety and Quality Principles' at all times

Required

  • Bilingual in Portuguese and English, strongly preferred
  • Education in Geomatics, Surveying Science
  • Relevant industry experience or military/academic experience in survey related discipline
  • Satisfactory completion of the competence criteria for Surveyor Grade I
  • Nominally 24 months experience, including 200 operational days offshore as a Surveyor Grade I

Overview

Join to apply for the Process Engineer Specialist role at Shape Digital .

An Industrial Process Engineer here at Shape works closely with a multidisciplinary Agile team to build cutting-edge advanced analytics solutions. These solutions will generate insights from our connected data, enabling the team to advance the data-driven decision-making capabilities of our enterprise. This role requires a deep understanding of engineering, troubleshooting, and monitoring of industrial processes and equipment. They work closely with Data Scientists and Product Owners to ensure business value and quality.

Responsibilities

  • Act as the technical mentor and facilitator in the development of studies of process and performance for operational efficiency and compliance with the international standards for quality and safety.
  • Contribute to developing advanced analytics solutions for condition monitoring and performance optimization of industrial assets.
  • Compile and digest industrial technical documentation as operational manuals, datasheets and P&IDs to gather information that will be utilized as input for data-driven models.
  • Develop root cause analysis studies of industry failure events to identify new opportunities for development and improvement of Shape's portfolio of digital solutions.
  • Explore and develop mathematical modeling of industrial thermodynamic processes to support data-driven solutions development.
  • Explore historical time-series data of process equipment to validate hypotheses and test modeling techniques.
  • Implement Shape's digital products in new clients as well as supporting development of new features.
  • Problem framing: participate in problem framing together with business owners, data scientists and other engineers for identified opportunities.

Requirements

  • Degree in Chemical Engineering or a related field, with a deep understanding of process engineering theories and practices.
  • Proven experience in the Oil & Gas industry, with strong knowledge of industrial processes, operations, and predictive monitoring of critical assets.
  • Solid understanding of industrial systems and equipment, including practical knowledge of sensing technologies, protection systems, performance control, efficiency optimization, technical specifications, and common failure modes.
  • Hands-on experience with PI AF (Asset Framework) for data analysis and the development of predictive models, driving actionable insights and process improvements.
  • Expertise in asset performance and integrity management, with the ability to lead and facilitate structured engineering studies such as HAZOP, HAZID, RCA, FMEA, and RCM.
  • In-depth knowledge of industrial process operations and control, enabling the analysis of systems involving multiple interconnected pieces of equipment.
  • Basic knowledge of industrial automation, including Distributed Control Systems (DCS), dedicated protection systems, and condition monitoring technologies.
  • Technical familiarity with data collection and storage systems, including vibration data acquisition, PIMS platforms, and OPC servers.
  • Working knowledge of data analysis, machine learning algorithms, and digital software system architectures.
  • Experience with agile methodologies and tools for continuous improvement and process optimization.
  • Language: Advanced English proficiency.
  • Certification: CREA certification is mandatory.
  • Willingness to work at our offices in Rio de Janeiro and São Paulo.

Benefits

Overview

A equipe da Amazon Logística está em busca de um(a) Gerente de Turno para se juntar à equipe da AMZL Brasil em nossa estação de entrega (Delivery Station) do Rio de Janeiro - RJ, no turno noturno.

Como Gerente de Turno, você será responsável por liderar a operação noturna de uma Estação de Entrega. Seu papel envolverá fornecer suporte e liderança para Líderes de Equipe, Operadores e Prestadores de Serviços de Entrega, além de gerenciar relacionamentos e o desempenho de agências externas.

Você fará parte de um ambiente altamente colaborativo, dinâmico e inovador, onde ideias são valorizadas e experimentação é incentivada. Nosso objetivo é encontrar soluções criativas e práticas para entregar os melhores resultados aos nossos clientes. Buscamos profissionais com um histórico de excelência em qualidade e foco no cliente, que prosperem em cenários rápidos e desafiadores, e que estejam prontos para atuar em contextos de alta ambiguidade e constantes mudanças.

Se você gosta de desafios e está preparado para liderar e entregar resultados em um ambiente que combina o dinamismo de uma start-up com a estrutura de uma grande empresa, queremos conhecer você!

Key job responsibilities

  • Estar baseado em um de nossos postos de entrega, no turno da noite. A Amazon opera 24 horas por dia, 7 dias por semana, portanto, o trabalho em turnos fará parte dessa função, incluindo finais de semana e feriados;
  • Supervisão da operação que foca na entrega de pedidos da Amazon direto aos clientes;
  • Apoiar sua equipe de líderes operacionais na gestão diária do posto de entrega. Isso incluirá alocação de mão de obra, liderança de reuniões, atribuição de tarefas e comunicação com fornecedores internos e externos;
  • Trabalhar com KPIs como On Time Dispatch, First Day Delivery Success e melhorar o atendimento ao cliente;
  • Pensar analiticamente sobre gerenciamento de projetos com atenção aos detalhes, capacidade de influenciar os outros e habilidades organizacionais excepcionais;
  • Ser obcecado por métricas e mergulhar fundo para encontrar as causas raízes rapidamente para gerar melhorias;
  • Encontrar soluções práticas e simples para problemas complexos sem sacrificar a qualidade ou a funcionalidade principal. Utilizando habilidades excepcionais de resolução de problemas e comunicação para influenciar o público comercial e técnico;
  • Fornecer suporte diário durante a implantação/implementação de novos sistemas/processos e coletar feedback;
  • Mapeamento de requisitos de negócios, entendimento de processos de negócios, estudo e análise de fluxos de trabalho e desenho de soluções;
  • Utilizar continuamente ferramentas de software e hardware para garantir operações normais do dia a dia. Garantir que os associados tenham as ferramentas adequadas para realizar o trabalho e coordenar o reparo ou substituição quando necessário;
  • Comunicar métricas diárias e relatar exceções a outros departamentos de Operações e em toda a Amazon, conforme necessário.

Qualifications

  • Ensino Superior completo em Engenharia, Administração, Operações ou áreas relacionadas;
  • Experiência em Operações de segmentos como Logística, Manufatura, Indústria geral e áreas afins;
  • Experiencia com gestão de pessoas;
  • MS Office, com nível intermediário em Excel (vlookup, fórmulas avançadas, tabelas dinâmicas, macros);
  • Disponibilidade para trabalhar no período da noite (23h as 10h) e em turnos flexíveis, incluindo fins de semana e feriados;
  • Inglês intermediário e Português fluente;
  • Experiencia em E-commerce;
  • Conhecimentos em gestão de projetos ou de processos;
  • Inglês Avançado.

description:
Overview

At Amazon we treat every single day like its day one. And we never sit still while we do it. Are you up for crafting solutions and solving tomorrow’s problems today? Then we have the opportunity for you!

We’re seeking a Delivery Station Manager to join our Amazon Logistics team in Rio de Janeiro - RJ. You’ll operate out of one of our dynamic Delivery Stations: they are at the heart of Amazon’s rapidly growing Operations and Logistics network: they’re where we sort and process our parcels.

As a Delivery Station Manager, you’ll deliver inspiring, supportive leadership for the teams you lead. But at the same time, you don’t shy away from rolling up your sleeves and getting involved whenever necessary.

You’ll be directly responsible for developing a team of Shift Managers and their direct reports: meanwhile, you will report to the Senior Operations Manager. The quality of your leadership is key to success in this role: you’ll tactfully motivate and inspire your teams to do their best work, while planning schedules and activities that balance their needs with that of the business.

Another key aspect of the role is to lead on numerous process improvement projects, with the aim of streamlining all activities, both for yourself and the team members you lead. title: Project Manager Brazil - Renewable Natural Gas
description:
Join to apply for the Project Manager Brazil - Renewable Natural Gas role at Waga Energy

Waga Energy was established to further our founders' commitments to preserving the common good and acting collectively to ensure a sustainable future.

Committed to the fight against global warming and to a sustainable energy transition, Waga Energy has developed a breakthrough technology to recover landfill gas into biomethane, also called Renewable Natural Gas (RNG). Our WAGABOX landfill gas upgrading units deliver high-quality biomethane, regardless of the quality of the raw biogas. The biomethane produced by the WAGABOX can be injected directly into the gas grid or used as fuel for vehicles. Waga Energy builds, owns, operates, and maintains the WAGABOX units under long-term contracts with landfill owners.

Already in operation at dozens of landfill sites worldwide, this revolutionary landfill gas purification solution has been producing clean, local renewable energy since 2015. Waga Energy is committed to driving a sustainable energy transition by making RNG accessible to all.

Guided by the values of Audacity, Mastery, and Cooperation, Waga Energy employees in Europe, North America, and other locations are united by a common purpose: maintaining a livable planet for future generations.

About the Position - Responsibilities & Duties

Waga Energy is currently seeking candidates for the position of Project Manager in Brazil (RJ or SP area).

The ability to accommodate +/- 25% domestic travel time (including overnight stays) and site work is required for this position. Some international travel may also be required.

This is an exciting, rewarding position promoting the role of renewable energies, notably renewable gas, in the future of energy transition.

The Project Manager will serve as a member of a collaborative project team (based in France), responsible for managing landfill biogas-to-RNG projects via the successful delivery and operations of our WAGABOX units. The Project Manager role is a highly responsible role supporting projects from the initial feasibility analysis stage through planning, design, permitting, construction, and ongoing operations.

Associated responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

  • Managing technical challenges, project management responsibilities, and client/project partner relationships to ensure both successful project execution and professional growth and advancement.
  • Developing and executing project scope, budget, and schedule from FEED studies through to project delivery and site construction, while ensuring adherence to timeline, cost, quality and safety objectives.
  • Managing all applicable regulatory and permitting related tasks to ensure compliance with local, state, national, and industry codes and standards, including drafting and tracking requests for authorization.
  • Managing the procurement of local equipment, supplies, and services essential for delivering the project within established budget and schedule, and assisting the project team in France with procurement made in France, while ensuring that engineering and process documents comply with local regulations and requirements. This includes coordinating with the Waga process department and outside equipment suppliers.
  • Tracking and documenting project information (internal and external) including procurement, scheduling, and progress documentation.
  • Managing subcontractors including subcontractor engineers, equipment manufacturers, and site contractors to obtain quotes/proposals, oversee work to ensure adherence to the project plan, budget, and quality standards, and track change requests.
  • Assisting the Business Development team regarding technical aspects of potential projects (site visits).
  • Managing civil work, pre-commissioning and commissioning activities: organize site construction in line with the schedule, manage site co-activity with safety and other rules, ensure subcontracting contracts are properly implemented, and involve other departments (EIA, process); participate in pre-commissioning and commissioning activities.
  • Ensuring the successful handover of new projects to the facility operations team.
  • Supporting ongoing operations via technical troubleshooting and system checks of WAGABOX units as needed.
  • Maintaining a continuous focus on safety and process optimization/improvement throughout all project phases, making suggestions and taking actions as needed.
  • Drafting grant applications when relevant.

About You - Qualifications & Skills

The ideal candidate is an enthusiastic, self-motivated professional with:

  • A bachelor’s degree in engineering (chemical, mechanical, process, electrical or related).
  • A minimum of 3 years of experience in a project management role.
  • Background in pressure equipment design, process piping, and rotating equipment.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office. Experience with engineering software (e.g., DraftSight, AutoCAD, or similar) is a plus.
  • Expertise in the conception and commissioning of equipment within gas, chemical, or heat production industries. Ability to work on-site to participate in pre-commissioning and commissioning activities.
  • In-depth knowledge of engineering documentation and its practical application.
  • Solid understanding of electrical and automation systems.
  • Proven experience in project management and EPC project control, ensuring successful project execution.
  • Knowledgeable in contracts, budgeting, accounting, and supply chain management.
  • Familiar with relevant ASME codes, as well as civil and structural engineering principles.
  • Excellent relationship-building and communication skills, fostering a collaborative and productive work environment.
  • Fluent in Portuguese and English (knowledge of French is a plus).

Resume and cover letters have to be sent in English.

Culture

Faced with the urgent need to act to reduce greenhouse gas emissions, Waga Energy employees have committed themselves to take meaningful action to contribute to sustainable energy transition and the construction of a more environmentally friendly society. In serving as members of this committed team of professionals, Waga Energy employees are supported in meeting their professional development and career advancement goals within a fair, ethical culture focused on cooperation, humility, integrity, respect, and teamwork.

  • Human resources presents an employment offer.

Waga Energy is an equal opportunity employer.

description:
Join to apply for the Digital Product Manager role at Darkroom .

About Darkroom

Darkroom is a progressive omnichannel growth marketing agency focused on retail, e-commerce, and consumer businesses. We have been recognized as one of the fastest growing private companies in America by Inc. ), a top 1% digital advertiser by Varos (2023), and our founders were named Forbes 30 Under 30 recipients for Marketing and Advertising North America (2024).

If you excel in managing complex projects, are detail-oriented, and possess excellent communication skills, we’d love to hear from you.

This is a fully remote role operating in the EST Time Zone and all business is conducted 100% in English. Open to candidates in the following locations: Portugal, Spain and Brazil.

What You'll Do

Shopify Expertise

  • Create and optimize data-driven CRO strategies (e.g., A/B testing, funnel optimization) to enhance user engagement and increase conversions.
  • Performing maintenance, analysis, optimization, and developing new site features and updates.

Project Management

Technical Leadership

  • Ensure project feasibility and alignment with e-commerce best practices.
  • Evaluate third-party tools and APIs for seamless integration into the website.
  • Stay updated on Shopify features, updates, and industry trends to recommend site improvements.

Collaboration and Communication

  • Serve as the primary point of contact between technical teams, external vendors, and stakeholders.
  • Translate business requirements into actionable tasks for developers.
  • Foster effective communication and resolve problems across all project teams.

You Should Apply if this Sounds Like You

Experience

  • 2 - 3 years in e-commerce or web project management.

  • Hands-on Shopify experience.
  • Familiarity with Shopify APIs and third-party tool integrations.

Skills

  • Experience with HTML, CSS is a plus

What it's like to work at Darkroom

Our team is our most sacred asset, and we offer highly competitive salaries and the following perks:

  • Unlimited Vacation Policy, and Holidays: Rebooting is one of the most important parts of growth. At Darkroom, you have access to a flexible vacation policy, and 10 holidays throughout the year to keep you recharged and sharp.
  • Location, location, (or no) location: Remote-first culture with a strong community base. With Hubs in LA, The Bay Area, New York, Philly, Sao Paulo, Lisbon, and Eastern Europe.

title: Health Coach
description:
Overview

Join to apply for the Health Coach role at Inside Higher Ed .

The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Hiring staff “for fit” makes significant contributions to Howard University’s overall mission. At Howard University, we prioritize well-being and professional growth.

Here Is What We Offer

  • Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus mental health support
  • Work-Life Balance: PTO, paid holidays, flexible work arrangements
  • Financial Wellness: Competitive salary, 403(b) with company match
  • Professional Development: Ongoing training, tuition reimbursement, and career advancement paths
  • Additional Perks: Wellness programs, commuter benefits, and a vibrant company culture

Join Howard University and thrive with us!

Job Function and Purpose

Basic Function : The purpose of this position is to evaluate and improve the health and wellness of clients. The position is responsible for the supervision of medical and clerical staff in collaboration with the Medical Director to maintain quality services and efficient operations.

Supervision

Responsible for orienting and training medical and clerical staff and assigning and reviewing their work. May also be responsible for acting in a “lead” or “senior” capacity over other positions performing essentially the same work, or related technical tasks and reporting to a higher level on a formal basis.

Nature and Scope

Internal contacts include medical faculty, Faculty Practice Plan staff, HU/HUH staff, third party payers. External contacts include executive alumni, vendors/contractors, and general public and external agencies.

Principal Accountabilities

  • Guide clients toward optimal health within the continuum of chronic disease to well-being.
  • Facilitate client’s behavior change using mindfulness skills and motivational interviewing.
  • Counsel clients to assess their overall health and determine long-term goals.
  • Help clients develop strategies for achieving goals.
  • Collaborate with provider to ensure that strategies align with overall treatment plans.
  • Conduct one-on-one health coaching sessions by providing client education and instruction as directed by the provider.
  • Coordinate medical referrals from provider to specialists for clients with chronic comorbidities.
  • Maintain referral log/referral tracking system and distribute to the appropriate provider.
  • Record patients' medical history, vital statistics, and information such as test results in medical records.
  • Retrieve lab reports, dictations, and files and maintain orderly records.
  • Prepare treatment rooms for patient examinations, keeping the rooms neat and clean.
  • Authorize drug refills and provide prescription information to pharmacies.
  • Clean and sterilize instruments and dispose of contaminated supplies.
  • Prepare and administer immunizations and medications as directed by a provider.
  • Manage vaccine inventory for your clinic.
  • Order all necessary vaccines and medical supplies for the efficient operation of the clinic to ensure compliance with current healthcare regulations, medical laws, and high ethical standards.
  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date client records and documentation in accordance with grant guidelines and confidentiality requirements.
  • Assist in data collection and outcome measurement efforts, ensuring the timely and accurate reporting for grant effectiveness.
  • Identify, analyze, and interpret trends or patterns in complex data in core performance measures that are most critical to the care and treatment of patients.
  • Monitor health and immunization status of clients to improve patient outcomes.
  • Supervise all medical and clerical staff to ensure adherence to policies, procedures, and standard systems.
  • Implement and supervise effective front office business processes, including liaison between the clinic and FPP administration to assist with closures of provider schedules and support the medical director in daily work and performance of staff.
  • Make recommendations for staff to receive appropriate training and support to perform job functions.
  • Keep leadership informed about staff performance.
  • Coordinate and oversee regular building maintenance and repairs.
  • Represent department appropriately and maintain effective relationships within the clinical enterprise including ancillary departments, HUH, Faculty Practice Plan Business Office, employers, and other key constituencies.
  • Performs other business duties as assigned.

Core Competencies

  • Knowledge of supervisory practices and principles.
  • Skill in organizing work of self and others.
  • Ability to plan, organize, coordinate and prioritize work in situations with diverse demands.
  • Knowledge of personal computer and word-processing, database, spreadsheet, and presentation software.
  • Knowledge of clinic operations to perform administrative/clerical functions and requirements of the organization.
  • Knowledge of examination, diagnostic and treatment room procedures.
  • Knowledge of Medical Terminology.
  • Knowledge of common safety hazards and precautions to maintain a safe work environment.
  • Skill in assisting in a variety of treatments and medications as directed. Skill in taking vital signs.
  • Skill in maintaining records and recording test results.
  • Skill in establishing and maintaining effective working relationships with clients, medical staff, and the public.
  • Detail-oriented with the ability to follow established priorities or procedures and deliver quality customer service.
  • Ability to use good judgment, make sound decisions and demonstrate tact and diplomacy.
  • Ability to maintain quality control standards.
  • Ability to react calmly and effectively in emergency situations.
  • Ability to establish and maintain effective working relationships with patients, employees, and the public.
  • Ability to communicate with people from various educational levels and backgrounds.

Minimum Requirements

Bachelor’s Degree and 1-3 years of related work experience. 8 years of related work experience in health coaching, wellness, or a related field (e.g., counseling, fitness, or healthcare) may be substituted in lieu of educational qualifications. Relevant Experience: Certification from a recognized health coaching program (e.g., National Board for Health & Wellness Coaching, ACE, ICF) is required. Previous supervisory responsibility required.

$60,000-$70,000

Overview

Nossas equipes de logística estão mudando a maneira como interagimos com clientes em todo o mundo todos os dias e resolvendo alguns dos maiores desafios logísticos enfrentados não apenas pela Amazon, mas também por toda a indústria. A função envolve prosperar e entregar resultados em um ambiente ambíguo, rápido e dinâmico, em um espaço colaborativo que é mais próximo de uma start-up do que de uma grande empresa.

Responsabilidades

  • Estar presencialmente na estação de entrega; trabalhar em turnos variados, incluindo finais de semana e feriados.
  • Criar e cultivar um ambiente de trabalho seguro, identificando oportunidades de segurança na área de trabalho.
  • Liderar e treinar os associados para entregar o melhor serviço aos nossos clientes.
  • Garantir que os pedidos dos clientes sejam atendidos de acordo com diretrizes de segurança e qualidade.
  • Fornecimento contínuo de informações críticas relacionadas ao turno aos operadores.
  • Envolver-se com funções de suporte e/ou outros departamentos para abordar problemas ou necessidades de indicadores de desempenho (ex.: readiness, 5S, segurança, treinamento).
  • Monitorar o andamento das rotas, identificar desvios e ajustar com foco na superação da expectativa do cliente e no gerenciamento dos custos de operação.
  • Conduzir reuniões, atribuir funções e trabalhar com KPIs como despacho pontual, sucesso na entrega no primeiro dia e melhoria do atendimento ao cliente.
  • Focar em métricas e identificar causas raízes para impulsionar melhorias.
  • Encontrar soluções práticas para problemas complexos sem comprometer a qualidade ou a funcionalidade principal.
  • Fornecer suporte diário durante o lançamento/implementação de sistemas e processos mais novos e coletar feedback.
  • Utilizar ferramentas de software e hardware para garantir operações diárias; garantir que os associados tenham ferramentas adequadas e coordenar reparo ou substituição quando necessário.
  • Comunicar métricas diárias e relatar exceções a outros departamentos em Operações e na Amazon, conforme necessário.

Requisitos / Qualificações

  • Capacidade de liderar e treinar equipes; foco em resultados e KPIs.
  • Disposição para trabalhar em turnos 24-7, incluindo finais de semana e feriados.
  • Habilidade para prosperar em um ambiente rápido, ambíguo e colaborativo.
  • Engajamento com melhoria contínua, análise de métricas e resolução de problemas.
  • Uso de ferramentas de software e hardware para operações diárias;
  • Comunicação eficaz e capacidade de reportar status e questões a várias áreas.

Nossa cultura inclusiva capacita os Amazonians a oferecer os melhores resultados para nossos clientes. Não celebramos apenas a diversidade de nossa força de trabalho, celebramos as diversas formas como trabalhamos. A infraestrutura do Hospital conta com dez andares, nos quais estão distribuídos os serviços de emergência e de Unidade de Tratamento Intensivo (UTI) adulta, pediátrica e neonatal; maternidade; clínica médica, cirurgia-geral e bucomaxilofacial, neurocirurgia, psiquiatria, pediatria e ortopedia. Exames de imagem (raio X, tomografia, ultrassonografia, eletrocardiografia, ecocardiografia) e laboratoriais também são realizados na unidade.

Devido à grande população de idosos da Zona Oeste, região assistida pelo Hospital Municipal Pedro II (HMPII), há duas Enfermarias destinadas ao atendimento desse público.

O Centro de Tratamento de Queimados é outro diferencial entre os serviços oferecidos, e que dispõe de uma UTI exclusiva para prevenir infecções, que podem ser muito graves para quem está com queimaduras.

Além disso, a unidade conta com a Coordenação de Emergência Regional (CER) Santa Cruz, que possui 39 leitos, e tem como objetivo absorver as demandas de menor complexidade, deixando o HMPII liberado para os casos de risco iminente de morte, necessidade de cirurgia urgente e/ou internação. Um diferencial deste CER é o fato de possuir atendimento especializado em Psiquiatria e Obstetrícia.

title: Microservices Engineer
description:
Overview

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution. The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.

This is a general selection track for teams that focus on back-end REST API microservices engineering in Go and Python. It covers all levels of seniority. Apply here if you are an outstanding engineer with crisp and well-articulated views on APIs, microservice design, engineering processes and DevOps. Our services need to scale to handle millions of Ubuntu clients, and collaboration across thousands of community members. As Ubuntu has been embraced by mainstream enterprise computing through the adoption of cloud and developer-centric tech strategy, the quality of these services has become more important to customers and users. We are growing our teams and aim to level up our insights on scalability, performance, resilience and DevOps practices. Key areas of interest for us are: API design, documentation, and governance; database performance design considerations; multi-region service delivery for resilience and performance; fuzzing and other proactive security analysis techniques; tracing and profiling for distributed systems insights; next-generation DevOps practices.

Responsibilities

  • Write high-quality, well-designed, and robust software that works at scale
  • Design APIs and software architecture for collegial review
  • Write tests that validate software behaviour
  • Build and maintain reliable, fault-tolerant applications and services
  • Collaborate proactively with a globally distributed team
  • Display technical leadership internally and within our external communities
  • Debug issues and produce high-quality solutions to resolve them
  • Contribute to technical documentation to make it the best of its kind
  • Discuss, contribute to, and collaborate across teams at Canonical
  • Work from home with global travel twice annually for company events

What we are looking for in you

  • An exceptional academic track record from both high school and university
  • Undergraduate degree in Computer Science or STEM, or a compelling narrative about your alternative path
  • Drive and a track record of going above-and-beyond expectations
  • Proficiency in Python and / or Go
  • History of writing modern, maintainable software
  • Experience with relational and non-relational database systems
  • Continuous integration and continuous delivery experience
  • Experience with systems programming or scalable web services
  • Professional written and spoken English
  • Experience with Linux (Debian or Ubuntu preferred)
  • Excellent interpersonal skills, curiosity, flexibility, and accountability
  • Passion, thoughtfulness, and self-motivation
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills
  • Result-oriented, with a personal drive to meet commitments
  • Ability to travel twice a year, for company events up to two weeks each

Additional Skills That You Might Also Bring

  • Experience with container tech such as LXD, Docker, and Kubernetes
  • Understanding of build systems and toolchains
  • Experience with cross-compilation
  • Experience with hyperscale public clouds and / or private clouds
  • Experience with designing, building, and running distributed systems
  • Performance engineering and security experience

What we offer you

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.
